create.name: Inayatiyya Hudson Valley Center
create.bio:
The Inayatiyya Hudson Valley Center is a local teaching circle of the Inayatiyya, the Sufi order that carries on the message of Hazrat Inayat Khan. It is based in New Lebanon, in the hills of eastern New York near the Massachusetts border, and meets at the Abode of the Message, the long-standing Sufi community on the site of a former Shaker village.

Its week has two fixed points. On Thursday evenings a different teacher from the circle gives a Message Class on Zoom, taking a theme from the lineage of Inayat Khan, his son Pir Vilayat and grandson Pir Zia, and drawing in other wisdom paths to show how religions agree at heart. Each class includes zikr, the chanting of sacred phrases, along with meditation and readings, and it is free and open to any sincere seeker. On Sunday mornings ordained ministers known as cherags lead the Universal Worship, an interfaith service in the meditation hall that honours the scriptures of many traditions and is streamed for those further away. The centre also runs a Ziraat circle that uses the imagery of farming and the natural elements as a spiritual practice, offers guided personal retreats, and marks Sufi anniversaries with music and celebration.

free_resources.title: Thursday Message Class
free_resources.description: Weekly class on Zoom every Thursday at 7 PM Eastern, given in turn by the centre's teachers on a theme from the Inayati Sufi teachings, with zikr, wazaif, meditation and readings. Free and open to all.

free_resources.title: Sunday Universal Worship Service
free_resources.description: Interfaith service every Sunday at 11 AM Eastern in person in New Lebanon, in the meditation hall of the Abode community, and also on Zoom, led by the centre's cherags.

free_resources.title: Previous Class Recordings
free_resources.description: Recordings of the Thursday Message Classes from 2025 and 2026, in a shared folder arranged by presenter.
